caption: The drawing depicts a circular object with a geometric, symmetrical design in the center. The main circular shape is filled with a star-like pattern formed by eight pointed, leaf-shaped segments radiating from the middle. The segments are shaded in tones of brown, giving the appearance of depth and contour. Surrounding the central star pattern is a border consisting of a series of repeating angled lines and pointed shapes, also rendered in various shades of brown. The outer edge of the circle is defined by a slightly darker brown line. The paper background is off-white with a subtle area of lighter shading behind the object, and there is handwritten text in the top right corner and the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" printed in red below the circle toward the right.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
